name: dh-emr
description: DH EMR - free EMR for global-health clinics. Two separate products over one shared core: DH EMR Field (offline paper-chart entry) and DH EMR Clinic (live, staff accounts and roles).

scripts.test:all: npm --workspace @dh/core run test && npm --workspace @dh/field run test && npm --workspace @dh/clinic run test
scripts.test:slow: npm --workspace @dh/core run test:slow && npm --workspace @dh/field run test:slow && npm --workspace @dh/clinic run test:slow
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --workspace @dh/core run typecheck && npm --workspace @dh/field run typecheck && npm --workspace @dh/clinic run typecheck
scripts.build:demos: npm --workspace @dh/field run build:demo && npm --workspace @dh/clinic run build:demo
